pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 12.4.1 AINA ZA SENTENSI SENTENSI TATA

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya sentensi tata ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za sentensi
2. kutambua sentensi tata katika matini
3. kuchambua maana mbalimbali ya sentensi tata

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya sentensi tata ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya sentensi tata ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua sentensi tata katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua sentensi tata katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuchambua maana mbalimbali ya sentensi tata
   In simple words: practise until you can kuchambua maana mbalimbali ya sentensi tata. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya sentensi tata ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za sentensi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 12.4.1 Aina za Sentensi Sentensi tata important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya sentensi tata ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za sentensi
2. kutambua sentensi tata katika matini
3. kuchambua maana mbalimbali ya sentensi tata

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
